{{Quote|And Tenke, he was with you when that detonator exploded on Ottega. He didn't make it out.|Drake Paulsen, to Toob Ancher|<ref name="Journal5" />}}
'''Ottega''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]] of the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]]. Situated on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], it hosted a warehouse in which, around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], a [[Unidentified would-be bounty hunter|would-be bounty hunter]] set up a booby-trap using a faulty homemade [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. When the explosive detonated it left the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Toob Ancher]] without his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]], his [[Gender/Legends|brother]] [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] in need of a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|leg]] implant, and seven other people [[Death/Legends|dead]], including the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] themself.

==Description==
Ottega was a notable<ref name="Guide3">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that had three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and occupied the third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ottega (star)|Ottega]] in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Ottega system/Legends|same name]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was situated in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]]<ref name="SWE" /> and the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]]<ref name="EGTW" /> within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Along with the rest of the Ottega system, Ottega was located on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Orocco system/Legends|Orocco system]] as well as the [[Noonian system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The planet shared its name with the [[Ithorian Herdship|starship]] ''[[Ottega Dawn]]''<ref name="Gunslingers">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> as well as the [[Ottegan mead]] [[Mead/Legends|beverage]]<ref name="Counterstrike">{{JournalCite|8|Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)}}</ref> and the [[Ottegan silk/Legends|Ottegan silk]] material.<ref name="Isard">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|You're starting to sound like my brother&mdash;careful, calculating&hellip; dull.''"<br />"''It wouldn't hurt for you to take a few lessons. If you had listened to him, you would never have gone to that warehouse on Ottega.|Toob Ancher and Drake Paulsen|<ref name="Journal5" />}}
[[File:Toob_Ancher_AJ5.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Toob Ancher was injured by a thermal detonator explosion on Ottega.]]
Between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], Ottega constituted a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="3 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{JournalCite|2|Out of the Cradle}}, which occur nearly a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after [[Toob Ancher]]'s loss of [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], to [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Toob Ancher]] planned to visit a warehouse on Ottega, a plan that his [[Gender/Legends|brother]] [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] unsuccessfully tried to dissuade him from. Toob was subsequently accompanied there by both Karl and the smuggler [[Tenke Hurn]].<ref name="Journal5" />

At the warehouse, a [[Unidentified would-be bounty hunter|would-be bounty hunter]] had booby-trapped a bulkhead with a faulty homemade [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. When the explosive went off, it blew away Toob's left [[Eye/Legends|eye]], left Karl in need of a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|leg]] implant, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] seven other people,<ref name="Journal2">{{JournalCite|2|Out of the Cradle}}</ref> including Hurn<ref name="Journal5" /> and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] themself.<ref name="Journal2" /> Toob eventually told [[Drake Paulsen]], the son of the smuggler [[Kaine Paulsen]], of the visit to the Ottega warehouse, and when Toob was affected by [[Amnesia/Legends|memory loss]] and delusions caused by the [[Bitter Winter]] [[Disease/Legends|disease]]<ref name="Journal5" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{JournalCite|5|A Bitter Winter}} to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Drake reminded the afflicted smuggler of that fact.<ref name="Journal5" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWAJ5.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ottega was first mentioned in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 5.]]
Ottega was first mentioned in the short story "[[A Bitter Winter]]," which was written by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] and published in the [[February]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal5" /> [[Stephen J. Sansweet]]'s [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' then [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] established that Ottega was one of the seventy-five planets of the Ottega system,<ref name="SWE" /> which had already been mentioned before in [[Bill Slavicsek]]'s [[1994]] ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''.<ref name="Guide2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, placed the Ottega system, and therefore Ottega, in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|"Tion" sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed Ottega in grid square M-6, far from the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the trio of [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] into which it was divided.<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book further overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by establishing that the system was situated in the Ottega sector.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> In addition, ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Ottega system in the Mid Rim,<ref name="TEA" /> thus overriding the earlier placement of the system in the Outer Rim Territories by ''A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded''.<ref name="Guide2" />
